lede: Every Descript plan, how many media hours and AI credits each one gives you, and the cheapest plan for the video and audio you edit each month.
calc_label: Minutes of media you upload or record each month
calc_note: The calculator compares plans by media minutes, the minutes of imported or recorded media Descript processes each month, per editor. AI features like Underlord, Studio Sound and generated media use AI credits instead: 400 a month on Hobbyist, 800 on Creator and 1,500 on Business. Enterprise is custom.

after_plans: Prices are per person a month. Media hours count media you upload or record in Descript, whether or not it is transcribed; AI credits pay for AI features like Underlord, Studio Sound, Green Screen, Eye Contact and generated media. Creator and Business can buy top ups for more media hours and AI credits. Enterprise has custom pricing, with AI credits and media hours sized to your team, SSO and SCIM.

compare.What you pay for: Media hours you upload or record, plus AI credits for AI features
compare.Free option: Free: 1 hour of media a month and 100 AI credits once, export up to 720p
compare.Most on a public plan: Business: $65/month, or $50/month billed yearly, for 40 media hours and 1,500 AI credits a month

faq: Free is $0. Hobbyist is $24/month or $16/month billed yearly, Creator $35/month or $24/month billed yearly, and Business $65/month or $50/month billed yearly, per person. Enterprise is custom.
What are media hours and AI credits?

Media hours track media files you upload or record in Descript, whether or not you transcribe them. AI credits track your use of AI features like Underlord, Studio Sound, Green Screen, Eye Contact and AI-generated media and avatars.
Yes. The Free plan includes 1 hour of media a month, 100 AI credits one time, limited AI tools and exports up to 720p. No credit card is needed.
How many people does each Descript plan include?
Hobbyist includes 1 person. Creator scales to a team of 3 and Business to a team of 5, each seat billed separately.
